guides.title: Crear aplicaciones externas FAP
guides.summary: An external app uses application.fam with FlipperAppType.EXTERNAL and an entry_point. Run ufbt in the project folder to compile a .fap in dist. Do not use launch/flash in automated tests.

guides.title: Furi GUI y ciclo de vida
guides.summary: Use furi_record_open/close for system services and allocate/free dialog or viewport resources symmetrically. Prefer reproducible examples over copying platform-internal APIs.

guides.title: uFBT: SDK, build y compatibilidad
guides.summary: Install official ufbt and run ufbt in a project root containing application.fam. It downloads a release SDK as required and writes dist/*.fap. FAP metadata carries SDK API version; build success is not a runtime compatibility guarantee.

guides.title: JavaScript nativo en Flipper (mJS)
guides.summary: Scripts use a constrained mJS runtime, with built-in print, delay and require('module'). Browser/Node globals do not exist. Scripts are copied to /ext/apps/Scripts and run without compiling.

guides.title: Event loop, GPIO y callback mJS
guides.summary: Import event_loop before gpio or gui. mJS callbacks cannot rely on normal JavaScript closures; pass extra arguments to eventLoop.subscribe. Check electrical limits and pinout before using GPIO.

guides.title: TypeScript SDK oficial
guides.summary: The official JavaScript SDK creates projects using npx @flipperdevices/create-fz-app@latest and transpiles TypeScript to Flipper-compatible JS. It is a separate workflow from native .js scripts; do not upload raw .ts as an mJS script.

guides.title: Versiones y símbolos FAP
guides.summary: Use targets/f7/api_symbols.csv and an indexed firmware snapshot for export evidence. Successful compilation does not prove that the installed device firmware exposes a particular API or that runtime behavior was tested.
